meta.label: Story: collect analytics
meta.description: Hub orchestrator for Story analytics: ensures the Postgres schema, then collects license / inventory / audit data from the local host and every remote-dss-host preset, writing to the configured Story PostgreSQL connection with per-(instance, source) transactional cursors. RAISES if any host or source fails, so the scheduling scenario's failure reporter fires.

params.name: hosts
params.label: Hosts (csv, empty = all)
params.description: Comma-separated host ids ('local' or remote preset names). Empty collects from every configured host.
